answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the falcon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The umber holds work receipts rather than names, so the velvet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
